//: Both commands run from apps/web (Vercel's Root Directory) and step up to
the repository root, because this is an npm workspaces monorepo: the
lockfile lives at the root and the dashboard depends on
@instant-mechanic/shared, which must be compiled before next build can
--include=dev is explicit rather than implied. Vercel sets
NODE_ENV=production for the build, and npm honours that during install by
skipping devDependencies — where TypeScript lives. That is exactly how the
first Render deploy failed, with 'tsc: command not found'.
buildCommand: cd ../.. && npm run build --workspace @instant-mechanic/shared && npm run build --workspace @instant-mechanic/web
